objects.name: Python
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse Python commands and scripts for execution. Python is a very popular scripting/programming language, with capabilities to perform many functions. Python can be executed interactively from the command-line (via the python.exe interpreter) or via scripts (.py) that can be written and distributed to different systems. Python code can also be compiled into binary executables.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020) Python comes with many built-in packages to interact with the underlying system, such as file operations and device I/O. Within industrial control system environments, Python libraries have been developed to implement multiple ICS protocols to establish communications with field devices. Adversaries can use these libraries or develop their own to execute commands on workstation, control server assets or send remote command messages to manipulate the industrial process through exisiting ICS protocols.
